description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI in the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It tests various aspects of the API, including fetching, deleting, and creating employee leave balance records, primarily by verifying responses and exception handling.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPITest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for the EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI, testing endpoints / delete, create, and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI, verifying the correct retrieval of leave balances.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling delete on EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving validation rules for delete throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling create on EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving validation rules for create throws a 'not implemented' exception.
